explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()` and collected only ordinary `#text` tokens plus the opener-carried text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA`, per the documented HTML Processor rules. The final string is truncated safely by Unicode code points with `mb_strlen()` and `mb_substr()` using UTF-8.
